name: Simulator: a trial that ends without a card is paused, then resumed on the old anchor (S97); with cancel it ends at trial end (S96)
description: R22 (Stripe trial_settings.end_behavior.missing_payment_method): nothing is invoiced at trial end; resuming with billing_cycle_anchor unchanged prorates the rest of the cycle onto the next renewal.

planSteps.description: Open the app home page and choose 'S97' in the 'Load scenario' dropdown
Assert the '✅ Matches golden expected' badge is shown
Assert Event 1 is 'Start trial' with trial end behavior 'pause', and Event 2 is 'Resume (undo cancel, or unpause)' with billing cycle anchor 'unchanged'
Assert exactly 3 invoices: 2027-01-10 totals $0.00, 2027-02-24 totals $48.65 with lines $19.65 and $29.00, 2027-03-24 totals $29.00. No invoice is dated 2027-01-24
Assert exactly 1 invoice is shown, dated 2027-01-10 with total $0.00, and the '✅ Matches golden expected' badge is shown
